interpretation: Task-preset controls differ from MSAR in widths/latent counts/blocks; NOT fair speed/accuracy or LRSA-paper reproduction.
limits: No real data, graph construction, task losses, time rollout, scheduler, epoch/convergence/accuracy/SOTA claim.

matrix.convention: Forward dense matrices only, 1 MAC=2 FLOPs. All other work separately inventoried; NOT all-operation total FLOPs.

saved_storage.kernel_cache_note: unique FP32 summaries written once; not training activation/allocator peak
saved_storage.current_latent_payload_note: FP32 residual representation; actual mixed activation dtypes in norm/SDPA ledgers
saved_storage.saved_storage_excludes: parameters, buffers, input backing storage; not allocator peak

coverage_training_only.note: Payload inventory, NOT peak/total upper bound: masked copies, backward, Up/SA activations and optimizer also allocate. See measured train peak. No inference coverage.
coverage_training_only.reduction: source SUM, batch MEAN, four-level MEAN, weight once; no additional dense QK/AV matrix MAC versus off

separate_nonmatrix.other: All bias additions, affine RMS/LayerNorm calls and executed scalar/reduction/copy ops recorded by live audit; inline Pair RMS covered here. SDPA softmax shape inventory also retained.

training_path.note: Unique autograd storage excluding params/buffers/inputs; NOT allocator peak; no graph retained.

untimed_eager_profiler.partial_flops_warning: not total FLOPs; SDPA and other unsupported ops can be omitted

measurement.timing: synchronized perf_counter; includes host launch/wrapper overhead; no data I/O
measurement.loss: explicit caller loss_closure; one model call/update, see caller objective metadata
measurement.memory_scope: forward: model+buffers+inputs+output/temporaries, no grads/optimizer; train: also grads+initialized AdamW states
